scope: Correct dense LDLsolve for inconsistent tall exact systems

limits: Complex and active callback requests use the existing checked Q(i) lane with at most 32 axes and 4096-bit rational components. Standalone literal-rational sparse inputs retain their sparse checked kernel. Underdetermined and rank-deficient systems refuse, including an empty RHS. No new symbolic fallback or portable matrix proof claim is introduced.
